- Paper: [Nature 2025](https://doi.org/10.1038/s41586-024-08243-y)
- ProteomeXchange: [PXD054790](https://www.proteomexchange.org/search?query=PXD054790)
- Dataset: 1,172 tumor samples from 22+ cancer types
- Method: Mass spectrometry (DDA) with Proteomics Ruler for absolute quantification
- Files: Already loaded in `data/proteomics/`

This is the complete picture of how the automated search system works and where to integrate the protein copy number data!
